hook: Your iPhone simulator now lives in Finder.

beats.say: SimDrop puts running iOS simulators in the macOS Finder sidebar, so you can drag files in and out of them like any folder.
Each booted simulator gets its own folder, with Photos and Videos for its photo library, and Downloads for the Files app on the phone.
Simulators appear when they boot and disappear when they shut down, and everything is also reachable from the terminal.
